newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hills shares slide on usage concerns.
newsitem.headline: Hills shares slide on usage concerns.

text.p: Shares in tollway operator Hills Motorway Group took a dive on Wednesday, losing nearly seven percent to an intraday low of A$1.96 following media reports raising questions over the usage of its M2 motorway in Sydney.
Traders said the June traffic figures, its first full month of operation, released on Tuesday, had raised questions about overall usage and whether it would meet its forecasts.
"It's gone down just on the back of those reports," said a dealer at a Sydney-based investment.
By 1.45 p.m.(0345 GMT), Hills shares were down 12 at A$1.98.
